gameDescriptionHtml:
SHOP SIMULATOR: SUPERMARKET – DESIGN, SELL & EXPAND – YOUR SUCCESS IS IN YOUR HANDS.

Put your entrepreneurial skills to the test in Shop Simulator: Supermarket. Immerse yourself in the world of retail and start your own business today! Will your small shop become a successful supermarket? It’s in your hands.

Playing with friends is even more fun. Coordinate your teammates, give orders via in-game voice chat, and fulfill your customers’ wishes. Together, you can make the supermarket of your dreams a success.

Game Features

  • DIFFERENT BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES – Decide what kind of shop you want to build. From a classic supermarket to a cereal shop with countless variations, or even a shop for animal food — the choice is yours.
  • DESIGN YOUR SHOP – Design your store exactly the way you want it. Choose from various shelves and decorations, place products as you like, and set their prices. Build the shop of your dreams!
  • MAXIMIZE YOUR PROFITS – Monitor stock levels, analyze sales data, and optimize your inventory to meet your customers’ needs. Keep an eye on market prices and order strategically to maximize your profits.
  • EXPAND AND GROW – Expand your shop and diversify your inventory to bring even more variety to your business. Hire employees to be able to focus on the critical aspects of your shop.
  • MONEY MAKES THE WORLD GO ‘ROUND – Scan products, charge the correct amount, and ensure that customers leave your store happy and satisfied. If too many customers come in, you can open a second checkout and staff it with an AI employee or a fellow player.
  • CLICK & COLLECT ORDERS – Move with the times and also accept online orders to reduce your customers’ waiting time and make additional profits. But be careful: you need to prepare the right products to satisfy the customer and complete the order successfully.
  • PLAY SOLO OR AS A TEAM – Setting up the store, stocking shelves, setting prices, ringing up customers, decorating… Everything is easier and more fun as a team! Work together like in real life and coordinate tasks using the proximity voice chat. The multiplayer mode for up to 4 players offers the ultimate supermarket fun!
